tables.name: users
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "users" (
  "id" bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  "username" varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  "email" varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  "emailVerifiedAt" datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  "passwordHash" varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  "2fa" varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  "role" varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USER',
  "perms" int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  "balance" decimal(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  "xp" int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  "anon" tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  "mentionsEnabled" tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  "banned" tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  "tipBan" tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  "leaderboardBan" tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  "rainBan" tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  "accountLock" tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  "sponsorLock" tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  "verified" tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  "affiliateCode" varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  "affiliateCodeLock" tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  "affiliateEarningsOffset" decimal(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  "maxPerTip" decimal(18,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  "maxTipPerUser" decimal(18,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  "tipAllowance" decimal(18,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  "rainTipAllowance" decimal(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  "cryptoAllowance" decimal(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  "mutedUntil" datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  "ip" varchar(45) DEFAULT NULL,
  "country" char(2) DEFAULT NULL,
  "lastLogout" datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  "createdAt" datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  "wagerRequirement" decimal(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  "wagerProgress" decimal(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  "profilePhoto" mediumtext,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  UNIQUE KEY "uq_users_username" ("username"),
  UNIQUE KEY "uq_users_email" ("email"),
  UNIQUE KEY "uq_users_affiliateCode" ("affiliateCode"),
  KEY "idx_users_createdAt" ("createdAt"),
  KEY "idx_users_role" ("role"),
  KEY "idx_users_xp" ("xp"),
  KEY "idx_users_banned" ("banned"),
  KEY "idx_users_sponsorLock" ("sponsorLock"),
  KEY "idx_users_accountLock" ("accountLock"),
  KEY "idx_users_leaderboardBan" ("leaderboardBan"),
  KEY "idx_users_lastLogout" ("lastLogout"),
  KEY "idx_users_country" ("country"),
  CONSTRAINT "chk_users_balance_nonnegative" CHECK ((`balance` >= 0))
)

tables.name: bets
tables.ddl:

  KEY "idx_bets_user_id" ("userId","id"),
  KEY "idx_bets_game_gameId" ("game","gameId"),
  KEY "idx_bets_completed_id" ("completed","id"),
  KEY "idx_bets_created_completed" ("createdAt","completed")
)

tables.name: transactions

tables.name: depositBonusRequests
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "depositBonusRequests" (
  "transactionId" bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  "userId" bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  "code" varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  "streamerId" bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  "version" varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  "rate" tinyint unsigned NOT NULL,
  "bonusAmount" decimal(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "wagerAmount" decimal(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "status" varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  "reason" varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  "acceptedAt" datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  PRIMARY KEY ("transactionId"),
  KEY "idx_bonus_request_user" ("userId","status"),
  CONSTRAINT "fk_bonus_request_transaction" FOREIGN KEY ("transactionId") REFERENCES "transactions" ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "fk_bonus_request_user" FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "users" ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "chk_bonus_request_status" CHECK ((`status` in (_cp850'pending',_cp850'awarded',_cp850'ineligible',_cp850'rejected'))),
  CONSTRAINT "chk_bonus_request_values" CHECK (((`rate` in (10,20,30,40,50)) and (`bonusAmount` > 0) and (`bonusAmount` <= 500) and (`wagerAmount` > 0)))
)

tables.name: depositBonusAwards
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "depositBonusAwards" (
  "userId" bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  "transactionId" bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  "bonusTransactionId" bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  "code" varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  "streamerId" bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  "depositAmount" decimal(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "bonusAmount" decimal(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "wagerAmount" decimal(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  PRIMARY KEY ("userId"),
  UNIQUE KEY "uq_bonus_award_deposit" ("transactionId"),
  UNIQUE KEY "uq_bonus_award_ledger" ("bonusTransactionId"),
  CONSTRAINT "fk_bonus_award_deposit" FOREIGN KEY ("transactionId") REFERENCES "transactions" ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "fk_bonus_award_ledger" FOREIGN KEY ("bonusTransactionId") REFERENCES "transactions" ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "fk_bonus_award_user" FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "users" ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "chk_bonus_award_values" CHECK (((`depositAmount` >= 40) and (`bonusAmount` > 0) and (`bonusAmount` <= 500) and (`wagerAmount` >= `depositAmount`) and (`transactionId` <> `bonusTransactionId`)))
)

tables.name: cashierDepositWagers
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "cashierDepositWagers" (
  "transactionId" bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  "userId" bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  "amount" decimal(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "remaining" decimal(18,2) NOT NULL,
  "firstBetId" bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  PRIMARY KEY ("transactionId"),
  KEY "idx_cashier_deposit_user" ("userId","remaining"),
  CONSTRAINT "fk_cashier_deposit_user" FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "users" ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "chk_cashier_deposit_amount" CHECK (((`amount` > 0) and (`remaining` >= 0) and (`remaining` <= `amount`)))
)
